rule.near_duplicate: min(pHash, dHash) <= 10 and SSCD >= 0.5, mirrored hashes included, or byte-identical (scripts/match_openviic.py)
rule.split_ov_dev: sha256('paperC|ovdev|'+image sha256) order: first half A, rest B; filter after
rule.split_xm: XM3600 minus XM600, sha256('paperC|xm|'+image sha256) order: first 500 dev, rest test
